notes.title: Mortisomem - 1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug that caused the signs on the map to not update properly when the player changed the language.

Thank you to all people playing Mortisomem, if you find a bug or another issue with the game, speak to the developer in: https://discord.gg/AygFDaujxC

notes.title: Mortisomem is a horror-adventure based in early 20th century Brazil
notes.notes:
Love retro styled horror adventure games? Mortisomem looks like it could be interesting, and another that's going with the old PlayStation 1 graphics style. Mortisomem is set in early 20th century Brazil and seems quite spooky.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/10/mortisomem-is-a-horror-adventure-based-in-early-20th-century-brazil
